The Chinese characters for Gerald

As a transliteration, Gerald is usually written 杰拉尔德 (Jié lā ěr dé). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Gerald comes from Germanic and means “rule of the spear”.

About the name Gerald

A Germanic name meaning 'rule of the spear', and the given name of President Gerald Ford.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Gerald suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
